retry.policy: Safe to retry. The purge is accept-then-poll: the first call records it in progress and hands the shard walk to a background timer, then waits a bounded time; a call while the purge runs, or after it completed, returns the current status without error, so after an ambiguous failure or a return with PurgeInProgress still true, read the deletion status or simply call again.

idempotency.basis: Accepting a purge that is already running or complete changes nothing and returns its status; the background walk resumes from its last durably recorded shard after a restart.

concurrency.rule: confirm must be true before irreversible purge.

retry.policy: Safe to retry: RequestUndoAsync records the undo intent once per resize operation id and acknowledges a repeat while that undo is pending; after the unwind is recorded a repeat throws InvalidOperationException whose message names the most recent resize as already undone, which is the benign terminal condition.

idempotency.basis: The undo intent is keyed by the resize operation id, so a repeat while it is pending starts no second unwind; once the unwind is recorded a repeat is refused because no resize remains to undo.

concurrency.rule: RequestUndoAsync is interleaved with the resize phase loop and writes only the separate undo-intent slot under a semaphore, so the undo is admitted even while a resize phase is in flight; the phase loop runs the unwind at its next phase or snapshot-slice boundary, and the call waits only a bounded time for it. A returned status with UndoRequested true means the undo was accepted and is still unwinding; poll GetResizeStatusAsync instead of retrying.
